name: @nextrap/nte-data-table
description: Native Light DOM data table with tbody-only scrolling, fixed sections and programmatic selection.

elements.name: nte-data-table
elements.description: Adds tbody scrolling, fixed table sections, column sizing/pinning and a selection Remote without replacing the native table.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible name for the keyboard-focusable scroll viewport.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: CSS height of the scroll viewport. Default: 24rem.

attributes.name: pinned-columns
attributes.description: Number of first visible columns pinned to the inline start.

attributes.name: scroll-label
attributes.description: Accessible label for the keyboard-focusable scroll viewport.

slots.description: Exactly one direct rectangular native table with thead, tbody and optional tfoot.

classes.name: style-default
classes.description: Default visual table style, added automatically when no style-* class is present.

classes.name: indicator
classes.description: Inline-end aligned indicator inside a table header cell.

classes.name: selected
classes.description: Selected row/cell; on a header cell the state propagates to its column.

classes.name: highlight
classes.description: Primary highlighted row/cell; on a header cell the state propagates to its column.

classes.name: highlight-primary
classes.description: Primary highlighted row/cell or propagated header column.

classes.name: highlight-secondary
classes.description: Secondary highlighted row/cell or propagated header column.

classes.name: highlight-success
classes.description: Success highlighted row/cell or propagated header column.

classes.name: highlight-info
classes.description: Info highlighted row/cell or propagated header column.

classes.name: highlight-warning
classes.description: Warning highlighted row/cell or propagated header column.

classes.name: highlight-danger
classes.description: Danger highlighted row/cell or propagated header column.

classes.name: border-free
classes.description: Border-free identifier cell; on a header cell the state propagates to its column.

classes.name: overflow-ellipsis
classes.description: Single-line ellipsis overflow treatment; this is the default.

classes.name: overflow-clip
classes.description: Clip overflowing cell text without an ellipsis.

classes.name: overflow-wrap
classes.description: Wrap overflowing cell text and allow the row to grow.

classes.name: overflow-visible
classes.description: Allow cell content to overflow visibly.

classes.name: nte-data-table-header
classes.description: Connected title/action/search wrapper before the table component.

classes.name: nte-data-table-search
classes.description: Search-field layout inside a data-table header wrapper.
